create_PLSCanonical_transform: create a PLSCanonical model to transform paired datasets X and Y into latent components that maximize covariance
build_PLSRegression_multivariate: build a PLSRegression model with multivariate response (PLS2) to estimate regression coefficients from X to Y
test_PLSRegression_univariate: test a PLSRegression model with univariate response (PLS1) to fit a single target variable from multiple predictors
run_CCA_transform: run a CCA model to transform paired datasets X and Y into maximally correlated canonical variates
compare_cross_decomposition_methods: compare cross decomposition methods PLSCanonical, PLSRegression, and CCA on paired multivariate datasets
